prompt:
You are a senior information designer and editorial typographer who sets data tables for high-quality publications (statistical yearbooks, reference works, financial reports, technical documentation) in many writing systems, including Chinese. You judge by looking at the real rendered result.

Judge a table layout on all of these levels, in this order of necessity but as one whole:
1. correctness — every character visible, structure intact, nothing clipped or overlapping;
2. readability — natural line breaks, words/numbers/identifiers/semantic units kept whole, continuous reading;
3. function — easy to look up, compare, locate and understand the information for this table's real reading tasks;
4. visual order — alignment, grouping, hierarchy, consistent scale for elements with the same role;
5. visual rhythm — proportion, density changes, distribution of white space, spatial relationships;
6. overall aesthetics — balance, restraint, naturalness, harmony.
Do not assume that equal widths, symmetry, minimum height, the fewest lines, the golden ratio or any fixed proportion is good in itself; decide from this table's function, content and reading task, and look for counter-examples to your own rules.

Table: 2024年重点信息化项目执行情况汇总表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Measured content facts (text px at 15px font, padding excluded):
  col 1: header "项目" · longest unbreakable unit 22px · widest one-line content 215px
  col 2: header "负责人" · longest unbreakable unit 16px · widest one-line content 46px
  col 3: header "预算（万元）" · longest unbreakable unit 60px · widest one-line content 92px
  col 4: header "进度" · longest unbreakable unit 48px · widest one-line content 373px
  col 5: header "风险说明" · longest unbreakable unit 38px · widest one-line content 1830px
Each column adds 21px of padding+border to its text width.
Viewport: 360px wide (dashed pink box in the renders). The table, including its 1px outer border, must be at most 360px wide (column widths sum to at most 359px); no horizontal scrolling. A table exactly 360px wide fits.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. Only the column widths are designed; row heights follow from them.

Your understanding: {"purpose":"汇总五个重点信息化项目的负责人、预算、进度和风险，供读者逐项核查执行情况。","tasks":["按项目名称查找负责人及执行情况。","比较各项目的预算、进度和风险。","沿单行顺序阅读项目、负责人、预算、进度与风险之间的关系。","细读较长的风险说明，理解项目执行中的具体问题。"],"relations":["每行的负责人、预算、进度和风险都属于同一个项目；进度与风险应结合判断。","预算适合跨行比较，项目名称用于定位并保持行的可辨识性。"],"roles":["表头标明五列含义；五个数据行分别对应五个项目。","项目列是查找入口，负责人列用于确认责任归属，预算列用于数值比较，进度和风险列提供执行状态及其背景。"],"keep_whole":["负责人姓名和预算数值应尽量各自保持一行。","预算表头中的单位应保持清楚；进度及风险文字中的数字、标识符和不可分割的语义单位应保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["较长项目名称可在自然语义边界换行。","进度和风险说明可按中文语义自然换行；风险说明尤其长，必然占用较多行。"],"same_scale":["负责人和预算列都承担紧凑的查找或比较任务，应优先保证完整显示。","项目、进度和风险列都需要容纳中文文本，但应按查找价值和文本长度分配不同宽度。"],"h_vs_v":"360px内同时容纳五列会迫使说明文字纵向展开；风险列稍宽可显著减少长说明的行数，但会压缩项目或进度列。保留项目识别和数字完整性后，需要在项目名称的可扫读性与风险说明的连续阅读之间取舍。"}

Image 1 is the one-line content overview. Then real browser renders of: d1r1A, d1r0B.
Measured facts:
d1r1A: column widths [54, 67, 81, 58, 99] px · table 360×2637 px · row heights [83, 571, 455, 455, 478, 594] · column headers on >1 line: 1/5 · tallest cell 25 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 51 · fits the 360 px viewport (no scrolling)
d1r0B: column widths [44, 67, 81, 69, 98] px · table 360×2637 px · row heights [83, 571, 455, 455, 478, 594] · column headers on >1 line: 2/5 · tallest cell 25 lines · measured breaks inside a word: 74 · fits the 360 px viewport (no scrolling)

Look at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design: what works, what is visually wrong, and the cause (which width). Then either propose up to 3 improved designs (refine the most promising, fix what you saw, or try an important unexplored idea) or, if further changes would not bring a meaningful improvement, set "done": true. Do not resubmit near-identical widths.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"best":["your best design name(s) so far"],"done":false,"designs":[{"widths":[int px],"change":"what and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"d1r1A","good":"表格完整适配视口；负责人和预算数值保持单行，便于逐行核查和跨行比较。项目表头及风险表头完整，项目名称比另一方案更容易辨认。","problems":"项目名称仍频繁拆成两字一行，进度文字也很零碎；预算表头分成三行，单位阅读不够连贯。风险说明很长，狭窄的行宽造成密集换行和很高的数据行。","cause":"项目列54px、进度列58px和风险列99px都受限；预算列81px虽能容纳数值，但不足以让表头完整显示。"},{"design":"d1r0B","good":"表格完整适配视口；负责人和预算数值保持单行。进度列加宽后，状态文字比d1r1A连续。","problems":"项目表头被拆开，项目名称几乎逐字竖排，严重削弱查找入口；预算表头仍分成三行。风险说明的密集换行和表格总高度没有改善。","cause":"项目列仅44px，扣除内边距和边框后容不下两个汉字；进度列增至69px占用了项目列空间，风险列98px仍然偏窄。"}],"best":["d1r1A"],"done":false,"designs":[{"widths":[65,67,81,60,86],"change":"加宽项目列以改善名称识别，进度列保留约两个汉字的空间；牺牲部分风险列宽度，检验查找入口改善是否值得增加的风险换行。"},{"widths":[54,67,81,50,107],"change":"保持d1r1A的项目、负责人和预算列，将进度列的一部分空间转给风险列，检验最长说明的连续性和行高能否明显改善。"},{"widths":[60,67,81,67,84],"change":"同时给项目和进度列更多空间，以改善逐项查找和状态阅读；检验进一步压缩风险列带来的代价。"}]}
